Up to two lanes of southbound I-405 from Southeast Eighth Street (milepost 12.8) to I-90 (milepost 
11.5) will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting the night of Tuesday, Oct. 27 to the morning 
of Wednesday, Oct. 28.

Southeast (milepost 8.5) to I-90 (milepost 11) will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting the 
night of Tuesday, Oct. 27 to the morning of Wednesday, Oct. 28.

will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting the night of Wednesday, Oct. 28 to the morning of 
Thursday, Oct. 29.

Signed detours will be available.

a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 26 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 30. A signed detour will be in

5 a.m., starting the night of Wednesday, Oct. 28 to the morning of Thursday, Oct. 29. A signed detour 
will be in place.

Signed detours will be available.

The Coal Creek Parkway Southeast on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 9:30 p.m. 
– 5 a.m., starting the night of Wednesday, Oct. 28 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 30. A signed detour 
will be in place.

The eastbound I-90 off-ramp to Factoria Boulevard will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting 
the night of Monday, Oct. 26 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 30. A signed detour will be in place.

The Coal Creek Parkway Southeast on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. 
– 5 a.m., starting the night of Tuesday, Oct. 27 to the morning of Wednesday, Oct. 28. A signed detour 
will be in place.

Up to two lanes of northbound I-405 from 112th Avenue Southeast/Lake Washington Boulevard 
Southeast (milepost 8.5) to I-90 (milepost 11) will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. – 1 a.m., starting the 
night of Wednesday, Oct. 28 to the morning of Thursday, Oct. 29.

Up to two lanes of southbound I-405 from Coal Creek Parkway Southeast (milepost 10) to Northeast 
44th Street (milepost 7.5) will be closed nightly from 10:30 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting the night of Tuesday, 
Oct. 27 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 30.
Southbound I-405 between SR 527 (milepost 27.1) and milepost 23.75 will be fully closed from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 30, to 4 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2.

The left express toll lane of northbound I-405 between SR 522 (milepost 23.5) and SR 527 (milepost 27.1) will be closed nightly from 8:30 p.m. to 5 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 26, to Friday morning, Oct. 30.

The right general-purpose lane of southbound I-405 between SR 522 (milepost 23.47) and Northeast 128th Street (milepost 21.45) will be closed nightly from 8 p.m. to 4:30 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 26, to Friday morning, Oct. 30.
Up to two right lanes of northbound SR 527 between mileposts 2.6 and 2.9 will be closed nightly from 11 p.m. to 4 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 26, to Thursday morning, Oct. 29.
The right lane of the westbound SR 522 off-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 8 p.m. to 4:30 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 26, to Friday morning, Oct. 30.
The Northeast 195th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 30, to 4 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2.
The southbound SR 527 on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 30, to 4 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2.
The Northeast 160th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 10 p.m. to 4 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 26, to Friday morning, Oct. 30.
The eastbound SR 522 off-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 10 p.m. to 4 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 26, to Friday morning, Oct. 30.
The northbound SR 527 on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 11 p.m. to 5 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 26, to Thursday morning, Oct. 29.
The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 195th Street will be closed from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 30, to 4 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2.
The southbound I-405 off-ramp to westbound SR 522 will be closed from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 30, to 4 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2.
The northbound SR 527 on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 30, to 4 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2.
The right general-purpose lane of southbound I-405 between mileposts 26 and 24.47 will be closed nightly from 10:30 p.m. to 4 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 26, to Thursday morning, Oct. 29.

Westbound I-90 is reduced to three lanes near the 17th Street Northwest on-ramp to the Lakemont Boulevard off-ramp, with traffic shifts to accommodate construction. The HOV lane is open to all drivers.

Up to three lanes of southbound I-405 between milepost 18.11 and milepost 16.45 will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. - 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 26 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 30.

Up to three lanes of northbound I-405 between milepost 17.45 and milepost 18.12 will be closed nightly from 10:30 p.m. - 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 26 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 30.

Two Express Toll Lanes (ETL’s) and one general purpose lane of southbound I-405 between milepost 19.84 and milepost 18.11 will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. - 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 26 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 30.

Two Express Toll Lanes (ETL’s) and one general purpose lane of northbound I-405 between milepost 18.3 and milepost 19.85 will be closed nightly from 10 p.m. - 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 26 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 30.

The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Sunset Boulevard North/SR 900 will be closed nightly from 10 p.m. –
5 a.m., starting the night of Tuesday, Oct. 27 to the morning of Thursday, Oct. 29. A signed detour will 
be in place.
The Northeast 85th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m. starting the night of Wednesday, Oct. 28 to the morning of Saturday, Oct. 31.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 85th Street will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m. starting the night of Wednesday, Oct. 28 to the morning of Saturday, Oct. 31.
The Northeast 85th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m. starting the night of Wednesday, Oct. 28 to the morning of Saturday, Oct. 31.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 85th Street will be closed nightly from 11 p.m. - 5 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 26 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 30.

The North Southport Drive/SR 900 on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 9:30 p.m. –
5 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 26 to the morning of Thursday, Oct. 29. A signed detour will 
be in place.
The Northeast 85th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 11 p.m. - 5 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 26 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 30.
The Northeast 85th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 10 p.m. - 4 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 26 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 30.
The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 85th Street will be closed nightly from 10 p.m. - 4 a.m. starting the night of Monday, Oct. 26 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 30.
The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 85th Street will close nightly from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m. starting the night of Wednesday, Oct. 28 to the morning of Saturday, Oct. 31.

The right lane of eastbound I-90 will close from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly between East Mercer Way and I-405 on Wednesday and Thursday nights, Oct. 28-29 and again from Monday through Thursday nights, Nov. 2-5, for bridge work. 

Delays are possible through the work zone each night.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Wednesday and Thursday nights, Oct. 28-29 and again from Monday through Thursday nights, Nov. 2-5, the eastbound I-90 on-ramp from East Mercer Way will close for bridge work.

Signed detours will be available.

Both directions of State Route 161 in Federal Way and Milton will reduce to one lane from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly between South 370th Street and Military Road South starting Monday, Oct. 26. 

At least one lane of SR 161 in each direction will remain open through this area each night. Construction is expected to occur Monday through Thursday nights until Friday morning, Nov. 6.

Until further notice, SR 161 is reduced to one lane in each direction between 36th Street East and Dechaux Road East on North Hill due to slide activity. Travelers can expect shifted lanes and congestion approaching North Hill.

From 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. Monday, Nov. 2, the northbound SR 167 express toll lane will close approaching Stewart Road for guardrail repairs. While the tolled lane will be closed for approximately 2 miles, the rest to the lane will still be tolled. Anyone using the tolled lane will be charged the toll they see when they enter the lane. Read the travel advisory.

Up to three lanes of northbound I-405 from Talbot Road South/SR 515 (milepost 3.5) to Sunset 
Boulevard North/SR 900 (milepost 5.5) will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting the night of 
Monday, Oct. 26 to the morning of Thursday, Oct. 29.

Up to two lanes of southbound I-405 from Sunset Boulevard North (milepost 6) to Talbot Road 
South/SR 515 (milepost 3) will be closed nightly from 10:30 p.m. – 4:30 a.m., starting the night of 
Tuesday, Oct. 27 to the morning of Thursday, Oct. 29.

The Northeast 44th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., 
starting the night of Monday, Oct. 26 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 30. A signed detour will be in place.
The left two lanes of southbound I-5 will close from 9:30 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 27, to 12:30 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 28, near South 178th Street (mileposts 153-152) for maintenance work.

The right lane of westbound SR 523/Northeast 145th Street will close from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. daily Monday, Oct. 26, through Friday, Oct. 30, from Interlaken Boulevard to Linden Avenue North for utility work.

Friday, Nov. 13, until the morning of Monday, Nov. 16 - Westbound SR 520 between Montlake Boulevard and I-5 in Seattle will close for construction beginning at 11 p.m. Friday until 5 a.m. Monday. During this time, all westbound SR 520 traffic crossing Lake Washington will exit at Montlake or Lake Washington boulevards. Those who need access to I-5 from westbound SR 520 will need to use alternate routes. Eastbound SR 520 and the SR 520 Trail are not affected by this work and will remain open.

Nightly from 11:30 p.m. to 5 a.m. the next day beginning Monday, Oct. 26 to 5 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 28, two right lanes of southbound Interstate 5 from James Street (milepost 165) to Lake City Way (milepost 170) will close for construction.
The express lanes are northbound-only 24 hours a day through the end of 2026 due to lane reductions for construction on the northbound I-5 Ship Canal Bridge.

Nightly from 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. the next day beginning Monday, Oct. 26 to 5 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 28, the southbound Interstate 5 on-ramp from Northeast 45th Street (milepost 169) will close for construction.
Nightly from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. the next day beginning Monday, Oct. 26 to 5 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 28, the southbound Interstate 5 on-ramp from Boylston Avenue (milepost 167) will close for construction.

Monday, Oct. 26, on most weeknights until Friday, Nov. 13 - The westbound SR 520 off-ramp to both northbound I-5 and East Roanoke Street will close for construction on most weeknights beginning at 10 p.m. until 6 a.m. The typical closure dates are Monday through Thursday evenings, though some nights could be canceled based on needs and/or holidays. During this time, all westbound SR 520 traffic that remains on the bridge past Montlake and Lake Washington boulevards will detour to southbound I-5.

Saturday, Nov. 7, nightly until the morning of Monday, Nov. 9 - The eastbound SR 520 off-ramp to Montlake Boulevard in Seattle will close for construction nightly beginning at 10 p.m. until 6 a.m. During this time, all traffic from I-5 that enters eastbound SR 520 will pay the SR 520 bridge toll. Those who do not want to pay the toll or who need access to Montlake from I-5 must use alternate routes.
From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Monday, Oct. 26, to Friday morning, Oct. 30, the Northeast 130th Street on-ramp to southbound I-5 will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.
The northeast 130th Street on-ramp to southbound I-5 will close from 5 a.m. Sunday, Oct. 25, through 6 a.m. Thursday, Nov. 5, for utility work.
The Mercer Street on-ramp to southbound I-5 will close from 9:30 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 27, to 5 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 28, for maintenance work.
Nightly from 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. the next day beginning Monday, Oct. 26 to 5 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 28, the southbound Interstate 5 off-ramp to Mercer Street (milepost 167) will close for construction.
The left lane of northbound I-5 and the northbound I-5 off-ramp to Mercer Street will close from 9:30 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 27, to 5 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 28, for maintenance work.
The Fifth Avenue on-ramp to the northbound I-5 express lanes will close from 9:30 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 28, to 5 a.m. Thursday, Oct. 29, for maintenance work.
The Cherry Street on-ramp to the northbound I-5 express lanes will close from 9:30 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 28, to 5 a.m. Thursday, Oct. 29, for maintenance work.

Up to four lanes of southbound I-5 will close from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Monday, Oct. 26, through Friday morning, Oct. 30, between Northeast 155th Street in Shoreline and Northeast 117th Street in Seattle for concrete panel repair. Expect delays through the work zone.

SR 202 will reduce to one lane between Tokul Creek and 361st Avenue SE from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Monday, Oct. 26, through Friday morning, Oct. 30, for rumble strip installation. 

Flaggers will alternate traffic through the work zone each night.
The right lane of northbound I-5 and the Interurban Avenue on-ramp to northbound I-5 will close from 10 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 29, to 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 30, for maintenance work.

The right lane of westbound SR 526 will close from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Monday, Oct. 26, through Friday morning, Oct. 30, between Seaway Boulevard and Evergreen Way (milepost 2-3) for utility work.

Beginning Sept. 24, 2021 until further notice: The southbound Interstate 5 Silver Lake Rest Area is closed for maintenance indefinitely. There is no access for recreational vehicle dumping at this location.
Northbound and southbound SR 9 will alternate from 9 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 29, to 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 30, near Index Junction (milepost 36) for utility work.

From 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings crews will alternate traffic with flaggers and pilot cars in sections between a nearly 11-mile stretch of SR 203, just south of Duvall to the Monroe city limits (mileposts 12.53 to 23.20).

Beginning Monday, Sept. 21 until 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 9: Nightly from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. (except Saturdays), State Route 203 traffic will alternate with flaggers from US 2 to Main Street (milepost 24) for utilities.

From 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings beginning Monday, July 27, one lane of State Route 203 will be closed for a paving project between just south of Duvall to the Monroe city limits (mileposts 12.53 to 23.20). Flaggers and pilot cars will direct alternating traffic through the remaining open lane.

Nightly, from 9 p.m. until 7 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings, contractor crews will alternate traffic through the intersections of State Route 525 in Mukilteo between Paine Field and the Mukilteo Ferry Terminal for pedestrian upgrades. Pedestrians may need to use local roads to detour around the work zone.
Eastbound and westbound SR 96 will alternate from 6 a.m. to 2 p.m. daily near Lark Dairy Farm (milepost 6) for utility work.
The left turn pocket will close between Westwick Road and Farm Road (milepost 11-13) from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. daily through Friday, Oct. 30, for utility work.
Lowell-Snohomish River Road will alternate traffic near SR 9 beginning Wednesday, Sept. 30.
